items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 07 May 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the North Sea and low pressure and associated frontal zone to the northwest of Scotland.


##Wind##

Southerly 3 or 4, increasing 4 occasionally 5 this evening, then veering southwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of a few showers to start and again later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 2 to 4, becoming variable, then settling north 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon, occasionally 6 in the west.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
